questions.stem_en: An operations dashboard has a CloudWatch Logs Insights widget that queries 40 log groups over the last 30 days and refreshes every minute. Only 3 of the log groups contain the relevant application logs, and the team only needs the last hour of data. The CloudWatch Logs Insights charges have become high. Which change will reduce the cost the MOST while keeping the widget useful?

choices_en.text: Query only the 3 relevant log groups, use the last hour as the time range, and refresh the dashboard less often.
Keep the query as it is, and increase the retention period of the 40 log groups so that queries can reuse old results.
Add a second widget with the same query so that the results load faster.
Keep the 30-day time range, and add a limit command so that only 20 rows are shown.

explanation.summary: CloudWatch Logs Insights の料金は、スキャンした圧縮前のログデータの量で決まります。クエリには必要なロググループだけを選び、時間の範囲をできるだけ狭くし、ダッシュボードのウィジェットは更新のたびに新しいクエリが走るので、更新の頻度を上げすぎないようにします。

per_choice.A: 正しい。スキャンするデータとクエリの回数の両方が大きく減ります。
per_choice.B: 保持期間を延ばしても、クエリがスキャンするデータは減りません。
per_choice.C: クエリの回数が増え、費用も増えます。
per_choice.D: 表示の行数を絞っても、30 日分を 40 のロググループでスキャンすることに変わりはなく、費用はあまり減りません。

references.quote: CloudWatch Logs Insights queries incur charges based on the amount of uncompressed log data scanned, regardless of query language.
Always specify the narrowest possible time range for your queries.
When you add a CloudWatch Logs Insights widget to a dashboard, ensure that the dashboard is not refreshing at a high frequency, because each refresh starts a new query.
Select only the necessary log groups for each query.

questions.stem_en: An application writes unstructured text log lines such as "GET /orders took 532 ms" to CloudWatch Logs. During incidents, on-call engineers must quickly find the average and maximum response time for each path, and every engineer in the same Region should be able to rerun the same analysis. The team does not want to move the logs or write code. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices_en.text: Save a CloudWatch Logs Insights query that uses parse and stats on the path and time.
Export the log group to Amazon S3 every hour, and analyze the files with Amazon Athena.
Create a subscription filter that sends the logs to an AWS Lambda function that calculates the statistics.
Have each engineer download the log streams and calculate the statistics in a spreadsheet.

explanation.summary: CloudWatch Logs Insights では、parse でログのフィールドからデータを取り出し（ワイルドカードか正規表現）、stats で集計の統計を計算できます。作ったクエリは保存でき、クエリはリージョン単位で保存されるので、同じリージョンで CloudWatch Logs を使える人はそれを見て再び実行できます。

per_choice.A: 正しい。ログをそのままにしてコード無しで集計し、保存したクエリを同じリージョンの皆が再実行できます。
per_choice.B: ログを移すことになり、エクスポートの手間と遅れもあります。
per_choice.C: 統計を計算するコードを書いて保守することになります。
per_choice.D: 手作業で時間がかかり、障害の時に素早く分析できません。

references.quote: parse Extracts data from a log field to create an extracted field that you can process in your query.
stats Calculate aggregate statistics using values in the log fields.
If you create and save a query, other users with access to CloudWatch Logs in the same Region can see all saved queries and their folder structures in the Region.

questions.stem_en: A security team queries several years of VPC flow logs in Amazon S3 with Amazon Athena. The table is partitioned by date and Region, so it has a very large number of partitions. Queries are slow, and an engineer must add new partitions to the AWS Glue Data Catalog every day. The table is queried only through Athena. Which solution will speed up the queries and remove the daily partition management with the LEAST effort?

choices_en.text: Turn on partition projection for the table with a configuration that describes the date and Region partitions.
Schedule a job that adds the new partitions to the AWS Glue Data Catalog every day.
Remove the partitions from the table so that Athena reads all the files in each query.
Copy the flow logs into CloudWatch Logs and query them with CloudWatch Logs Insights instead.

explanation.summary: パーティション射影を使うと、パーティションの多いテーブルのクエリを速くし、パーティションの管理を自動にできます。通常 Athena はパーティションを絞り込む前に AWS Glue Data Catalog に GetPartitions を呼びますが、射影の設定があれば Athena は自分でパーティションを組み立てられるので、その呼び出しが要りません。パーティション射影は Athena からクエリする時だけ使えます。

per_choice.A: 正しい。Data Catalog への呼び出しを避けて速くなり、新しいパーティションを足す作業も要りません。
per_choice.B: 手作業は自動になりますが、ジョブの保守が残り、パーティションの多さによる遅さも変わりません。
per_choice.C: 毎回すべてのファイルを読むので、かえって遅くなり、費用も増えます。
per_choice.D: 数年分のログを写すことになり、手間と費用が大きくなります。

references.quote: You can use partition projection in Athena to speed up query processing of highly partitioned tables and automate partition management.
Partition projection allows Athena to avoid calling GetPartitions because the partition projection configuration gives Athena all of the necessary information to build the partitions itself.
Partition projection is usable only when the table is queried through Athena.
